# Isometric stack — Style Prompt

> A calm technical explainer on a pale blue-grey page ruled with a faint 30° isometric grid. A chapter card opens it (a big index number in the one signal colour, a heavy title, a drawn rule, a mono label); a single colour sheet slides along the isometric axis to turn each page; flat slabs drop out of the sky and settle into a true-isometric stack, white with two grey side tones and only the top one in the signal colour, each with its label turned flat to the screen; a big figure counts up softly from a blur; a knife-thin underline marks the one word that matters. The camera never moves.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

The look makes **layers** legible: what a thing is made of, in what order, and which layer is the point. Everything sits on one flat page with a locked camera; the only depth is the isometric plane the slabs live on, drawn without a vanishing point. Volume comes only from three tones (top face, light side, dark side), never from shadows or blur. One signal colour does all the pointing (the index number, the top slab, the underline, the sheet), and the rest is white, two greys and ink. Text is set, not performed: it rises from behind a mask and stays still. Each page is a card (chapter, head with stack, stat, call to action) and the colour sheet turns between them.

Not a 3D render (no perspective, no camera orbit, no lighting or reflections), not pixel-art isometric (the angle is the true 30° projection, not a 2:1 stair-step), not a dashboard (one idea per page, at most four layers), not kinetic typography (no bouncing, spinning or per-letter tricks; overshoot is none), not a gradient stage talk (flat fills only).

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Page**: flat `--latar` with two repeating 1 px line sets at 30° and 150°, 56 px apart, at about 7% ink. Drawn once, never moves. (The source adds 1.5% grain; it is invisible after compression and is dropped.)
- **Slab**: a 420 px square laid on the isometric plane (`rotateZ(−45°) rotateX(54.7356°)`), which on screen is a 594 × 343 px rhombus. Its thickness is the square repeated 4 px at a time along the plane's diagonal, which projects to a band straight below the front edges: about 10 px of the light side tone, then 6 px of the dark side tone (16 px in all). Top face `--latar-2` with a 2 px hairline at 8-9% ink; the top slab of a stack is solid `--utama` with no hairline. Draw it in 2D: one SVG per slab with three polygons (dark band, light band, top face), moved only by transforms.
- **Stack**: slabs 120 px apart in z, which is 98 px on screen; the stack's centre sits at x 300 (left vertex at x 3, so the stack hugs the left edge), the bottom slab's centre at y 1210. Three or four slabs, never more.
- **Index on the slab**: a mono "L1", "L2"… printed in the slab's plane near its left vertex (52 px in plane coordinates, 34 px in and 26 px down from the corner), in `--teks-redup`; on the colour slab in `--teks-di-utama` at 85%. It is the only text that lies on the plane.
- **Label beside the slab**: billboarded flat to the screen, starting 36 px right of the slab's right vertex and centred 12 px above it, with a 3 px vertical tick in the signal colour and 18 px padding. It moves with its slab.
- **Sheet**: one full-frame `--utama` rectangle, flat, no shadow, used only as the page turn.
- **Palette tag**: in the lower left (top at y 1452), for the whole video: a 24 px mono line, the name in 54 px heavy type with a 34 px Latin subtitle in muted grey, and five 34 px dots: background (only its hairline shows), ink, signal, light side, dark side. It names who is speaking and shows the palette, and the sheet covers it like everything else.
- **Button** (call to action): a flat rectangle of `--utama` with radius 8 px over the same two-tone band as a slab (10 px light, 6 px dark), so it reads as a slab seen from the front; it presses down 11 px once.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar` is the page (#eef0f4); the grid is `--teks` at 7%.
- `--latar-2` is every slab's top face (#ffffff). With a dark brand it becomes a lighter panel of the brand's background, and the 9% hairline keeps the slab's edge.
- `--utama` is the one signal colour (indigo #4f46e5 in the source): the top slab, the sheet, the button face, a palette dot. As a word or line on the page it is `--utama-di-latar`: the chapter number, the knife underline and the word it recolours, the ticks beside slab labels, the underlined number in a source note.
- Side tones are mixed from the contract so the slab stays three-toned in any brand: light side = `--latar-2` with 13% `--teks` and 5% `--utama` (#d5d8e4 in the source), dark side = `--latar-2` with 32% `--teks` and 6% `--utama` (#aeb3c6). With a dark brand they mix toward the light text and read as lit rims, which keeps the edges visible on a dark page.
- `--teks` is ink: titles, slab labels, the big figure, the contact; the chapter rule is ink at 85%. `--teks-redup` carries mono labels, slab indexes, the Latin subtitle and secondary notes. `--teks-di-utama` is for the index on the colour slab and the button text.
- `--aksen` and `--aksen-di-latar` are **not drawn**: the look has one signal colour. Never colour a second slab, and never add a second accent even when the brand has one.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` (Inter 800 when the brand has none; Poppins 800 also suits) carries the chapter title at 124 px (one line; a wider brand font may take two, `text-wrap: balance`), page heads at 88 px, the unit under a figure at 80 px, slab labels at 46 px, the button at 46 px and the tag name at 54 px. Letter-spacing −0.01em, line height 1.04.
- `--font-isi` (Inter 400) carries notes: the source line under a figure at 44 px in ink, secondary lines at 38 px in `--teks-redup`.
- Look fonts that the brand does not replace: `--font-angka` Space Grotesk 700 for Latin numerals (the chapter number at 190 px, −0.04em, line height 0.9; the big figure at 300 px, −0.05em, with a `%` at 0.42em set high; the contact at 76 px; the tag subtitle at 34 px) and `--font-kode` IBM Plex Mono for labels (600, 26 px, uppercase, tracking 0.16em; the tag line 24 px, 0.2em; slab indexes 400 at 52 px in plane).
- Keep information text at 24 px or more, slab labels to about 12 characters at 46 px (their right edge stays left of x 960), and decimals in Indonesian ("91,7%").

## 5. Motion quality

- **Eases**: enter `power3.out`, exit `power2.in`, snap `cubic-bezier(0.7, 0, 0.2, 1)`, no overshoot anywhere.
- **Clip-rise** (every text block): the block rises from 108% below its own mask to 0 in 0.6 s `power3.out`; blocks of one card follow 0.1 s apart. Exit, when a card is not covered by the sheet: sink, opacity to 0 and 16 px down in 0.3 s `power2.in`.
- **Chapter card**: number at 0.07 s, title at 0.17 s, the rule scales from the left in 0.6 s `power3.out` at 0.5 s, the label rises at 0.55 s; then a still hold of 1.2-1.5 s before the sheet.
- **Knife underline**: a bar 0.09em thick, 0.06em below the baseline, scales from the left in 0.32 s with the snap curve; the word turns `--utama-di-latar` the moment it completes. It starts about 0.75 s after the head starts rising.
- **Slab drop**: each slab falls from 340 px higher in z (277 px on screen) with opacity 0 → 1, 0.6 s `power3.out`, 0.35-0.4 s apart (0.38 s in the example), bottom slab first, the colour slab last; the first drop starts about 1.1 s after the head. No bounce, no squash, no sound of impact on screen.
- **Soft count**: starts once the sheet has cleared. The figure rises 20 px and comes into focus over 0.7 s while its value counts from 0 in 1.4 s `expo.out`, one exact value per frame (so it seeks). The source blurs it 12 px → 0; the example shows a soft copy instead (the same glyphs drawn only as a 20 px text-shadow at half ink, in over 0.2 s, out by 0.7 s `power1.in`) under the crisp figure (in from 0.15 s over 0.6 s `power2.out`), so no blur filter is animated. The unit rises about 1.25 s after the count starts, the note 0.25 s later, its underline 0.35 s after that.
- **Holds**: a finished card holds completely still for 1-3 s; the last card holds at least 2 s (2.1 s in the example, after the button press at about 1.4 s into the card).

## 6. Camera grammar

The camera is locked: there is no drift, push or parallax. Every move is an object or the sheet moving on a still page.

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Locked frame | a diagram to read; nothing competes with the layer that just landed | every hold |
| Iso-slide sheet: in from the lower left (−110%, +63%) to cover in 0.42 s, out to the upper right (+110%, −63%) 0.03 s later, snap curve | turning to the next page of the explanation | between every card |
| Slab drop along z (277 px on screen) | a layer settling into its place | steps, the parts of a thing, what a package includes, a build |
| Clip-rise from the mask | a statement set in type, not spoken | titles, units, notes, contacts |
| Knife underline with recolour | this word is the point | the number of layers, a sample size, the call-to-action word |
| Button press (11 px down in 0.08 s, back in 0.2 s) | the action is physical and simple | the call to action |

## 7. Native moves

- **The stack drop.** Slabs fall one by one into a true-isometric stack, labels flat to the screen, the last and topmost in the signal colour. *Fits content like:* the three layers of a mechanical keyboard; a membership's three tiers with the best on top; a creator's workflow (ide, naskah, edit); the levels of a course; the floors of a house in a short story.
- **The iso-slide page turn.** One full-frame sheet in the signal colour crosses on the 30° axis, and the next card is already in place when it leaves. *Fits content like:* chapter to chapter of a lesson; product feature to price; problem page to answer page in a creator's explainer; scene changes in a serial story.
- **The chapter card.** A big index number in the signal colour over a heavy one-line title, a drawn rule and a mono label. *Fits content like:* "01 Rakit keyboard" for a workshop; episode 03 of a channel's series; Bab 2 of a story; the first of three tips from a clinic.
- **The knife underline.** A thin bar snaps under one word and recolours it. *Fits content like:* "cuma 3 lapis"; "110 dari 120 peserta"; the date a class opens; the one ingredient a recipe hinges on.
- **The soft count.** A 300 px figure comes into focus while counting, then its unit and a source note rise under it. *Fits content like:* 91,7% of students whose build works first time; 2.400 orders served; 48 videos published this year; 12 hours a character has left.
- **The palette tag.** A fixed corner card naming the speaker, with five palette dots. *Fits content like:* a studio's name and city; a channel's name and series; a teacher's class; the title of a story.

## 8. Pitfalls

- **Performance (live preview).** No animated `filter: blur()`: use the soft-copy text-shadow, painted only while visible. Each slab is one small SVG moved by transforms; the grid is a static background; scenes off screen are hidden with `autoAlpha`; the sheet is hidden except while it crosses.
- **Geometry.** Keep the true projection: rhombus width : height = 1 : 0.577 (594 × 343 for a 420 px square). A 2:1 pixel-art rhombus or a plain 2D rotation reads as a different style. Side bands hang straight down, never sideways.
- **Labels.** Only the short index lies on the plane; every real label is flat to the screen, right of its slab, one line. Keep labels short; a brand font that is wider needs a smaller label or a shorter word, not a second line.
- **One signal colour.** Never colour more than one slab, never tint the white slabs with the brand, never add a gradient or a drop shadow for depth.
- **At most four layers**, three reads best. A fifth idea is a new card.
- **Stillness.** No idle motion: the locked camera is what makes the drops readable. Do not float the stack or loop the grid.
- **Safe zones.** Reading text within y 180-1500, clear of the right 120 px from y 900 to 1500; nothing but the page below y 1620.
- **Light brands.** A pale main colour on white fails as a word colour: words fall back to `--utama-di-latar` (ink), while the top slab and the sheet keep the brand colour as fills.

## Measured from the references

- Film rhythm (13.4 s): chapter card 0-2.4 s, sheet 2.4-3.3 s, head with stack 3.0-8.4 s (three drops at about 4.2, 4.6 and 4.9 s, the full stack held about 3 s), sheet 8.4-9.1 s, stat 9.2-13.4 s (count lands at about 10.6 s, held about 2.6 s).
- Layout archetypes: chapter at the top (y 440), head at the top (y 420) with the stack below (list top y 1000, left 90), stat at the top left (y 380), tag at the bottom left (bottom 300). Margins 80 px left and right.
- Variation space: four slabs at most; two half-size stacks side by side for a comparison; a dashed, empty slab outline for a missing layer; a smaller copy of the stack (0.55×) as a closing emblem beside the contact.

# Isometric stack: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2.4, medium 3.4, long 4.8.

## hook

- en: chapter card: a big main-colour index number and a heavy title rise from masks, a rule draws under them, a mono label follows
- id: kartu bab: angka bab besar warna utama dan judul tebal naik dari balik masker, garis ditarik di bawahnya, label mono menyusul

## problem

- en: the stack drops with a gap: a dashed empty slab where a layer is missing, its label in muted text
- id: tumpukan jatuh dengan satu celah: papan kosong bergaris putus di lapis yang hilang, labelnya redup

## fact

- en: head card: mono label, one heavy line rising from its mask, the key word knife-underlined and turned main colour
- id: kartu kepala: label mono, satu baris tebal naik dari masker, kata kuncinya digaris pisau dan berganti warna utama

## step

- en: slabs drop onto the isometric stack one by one, 0.38 s apart, each with its label facing the screen; the top one is main colour
- id: papan jatuh ke tumpukan isometrik satu per satu, jeda 0,38 detik, labelnya menghadap layar; papan teratas warna utama

## compare

- en: two isometric stacks side by side drop layer by layer; the complete one gets the main-colour top slab
- id: dua tumpukan isometrik berdampingan jatuh lapis demi lapis; yang lengkap mendapat papan teratas warna utama

## number

- en: a huge figure soft-counts up from a blurred grey, the unit rises under it, a source note with one underlined number
- id: angka raksasa menghitung lembut dari abu-abu kabur, satuannya naik di bawah, catatan sumber dengan satu angka bergaris

## proof

- en: a short quote in heavy type over a single white slab, the name in a mono label, the deciding word knife-underlined
- id: kutipan pendek huruf tebal di atas satu papan putih, nama di label mono, kata penentunya digaris pisau

## offer

- en: the price on a main-colour slab dropping onto a short stack; what is included labels the slabs below
- id: harga di papan warna utama yang jatuh ke tumpukan pendek; isi paketnya jadi label papan di bawahnya

## cta

- en: head card, a slab-shaped button that drops in and presses once, the contact in big numerals, all held 2 s
- id: kartu kepala, tombol berbentuk papan yang jatuh lalu ditekan sekali, kontak dengan angka besar, diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: the full stack again with every label, the top slab main colour, the title's key word underlined, held 2 s
- id: tumpukan lengkap kembali dengan semua label, papan teratas warna utama, kata kunci judul bergaris, diam 2 detik

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1080, height=1920" />
    <title>Tumpukan isometrik</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Inter"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 800; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Space Grotesk"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 700; }
      @font-face { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 600; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. Gaya ini hanya punya satu warna
         sinyal (--utama); --aksen sengaja tidak dipakai. */
      :root {
        --latar: #eef0f4; --latar-2: #ffffff; --utama: #4f46e5; --aksen: #4f46e5;
        --teks: #1d2033; --teks-redup: #6b7088; --teks-di-utama: #ffffff;
        --teks-di-aksen: #ffffff; --utama-di-latar: #4f46e5; --aksen-di-latar: #4f46e5;
        --font-judul: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Inter", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        /* Milik gaya ini: angka Latin, label mono, garis grid, dan dua nada sisi papan (dicampur dari token brand,
           jadi papan tetap tiga nada di brand terang maupun gelap). */
        --font-angka: "Space Grotesk", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
        --font-kode: "IBM Plex Mono", "Noto Sans", monospace;
        --garis: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 7%, transparent);
        --tepi: color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 9%, transparent);
        --sisi: color-mix(in oklab, color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar-2), var(--teks) 13%), var(--utama) 5%);
        --gelap: color-mix(in oklab, color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar-2), var(--teks) 32%), var(--utama) 6%);
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); color: var(--teks);
        font-family: var(--font-isi); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
      /* Grid isometrik 30° dan 150°, jarak 56 px: digambar sekali, tidak pernah bergerak (kamera terkunci). */
      #grid { position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image:
        repeating-linear-gradient(30deg, var(--garis) 0 1px, transparent 1px 56px),
        repeating-linear-gradient(150deg, var(--garis) 0 1px, transparent 1px 56px); }
      .scene { position: absolute; inset: 0; visibility: hidden; }
      /* Teks masuk naik dari balik masker (clip-rise). */
      .mask { display: block; overflow: hidden; padding: 0.06em 0 0.12em; margin: -0.06em 0 -0.12em; }
      .in { display: block; will-change: transform; }
      .label { font-family: var(--font-kode); font-weight: 600; font-size: 26px; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      .judul { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 1.04; text-wrap: balance; }
      .angka { font-family: var(--font-angka); font-weight: 700; }
      /* Adegan 1: kartu bab (angka bab, judul berat, garis, label mono). */
      .bab { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 440px; }
      .bab .num { font-size: 190px; line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.04em; color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .bab .judul { margin-top: 26px; font-size: 124px; }
      .bab .rule { margin-top: 30px; height: 3px; background: var(--teks); opacity: 0.85; }
      .bab .label { margin-top: 30px; }
      /* Kepala adegan: label mono, lalu judul satu baris. */
      .kepala { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 420px; }
      .kepala .judul { margin-top: 20px; font-size: 88px; }
      /* Garis pisau di bawah kata kunci; kata itu ikut berganti ke warna utama. */
      .emph { position: relative; display: inline-block; }
      .emph[data-on="1"] { color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .pisau { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -0.06em; height: 0.09em; background: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      /* Adegan 2: papan isometrik sejati (rotateZ −45°, rotateX 54,7356°): wajah atas, sisi terang, sisi gelap. */
      .lapis { position: absolute; left: 3px; width: 1000px; height: 360px; will-change: transform, opacity; }
      .lapis svg { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; overflow: visible; }
      .f-atas { fill: var(--latar-2); stroke: var(--tepi); stroke-width: 2; }
      .lapis.u .f-atas { fill: var(--utama); stroke: none; }
      .f-sisi { fill: var(--sisi); }
      .f-gelap { fill: var(--gelap); }
      .idx { font-family: var(--font-kode); font-size: 52px; fill: var(--teks-redup); }
      .lapis.u .idx { fill: var(--teks-di-utama); opacity: 0.85; }
      /* Label papan menghadap layar (billboard), di sudut kanan papannya, dengan garis tegak warna utama. */
      .ket { position: absolute; left: 630px; top: 137px; padding-left: 18px; border-left: 3px solid var(--utama-di-latar);
        font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 800; font-size: 46px; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; }
      /* Tumpukan kecil di adegan penutup: papan yang sama, diskalakan 0,55 (wadahnya tidak pernah dianimasikan). */
      #mini { position: absolute; left: 545px; top: 1300px; width: 1000px; height: 0; transform: scale(0.55); transform-origin: 0 0; }
      /* Adegan 3: angka besar kiri atas, satuan, catatan sumber. */
      .stat { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 380px; }
      .val { position: relative; font-size: 300px; line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: -0.05em; white-space: nowrap; }
      .val span { display: inline-block; will-change: transform, opacity; }
      .val span::after { content: "%"; display: inline-block; font-size: 0.42em; letter-spacing: 0; margin-left: 0.04em;
        vertical-align: top; line-height: 1; padding-top: 0.1em; }
      /* Salinan lembut: bayangan kabur dari huruf yang sama, memudar saat angka tajam muncul (tanpa filter blur). */
      .val .lembut { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; color: transparent;
        text-shadow: 0 0 20px color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 50%, transparent); }
      .unit { margin-top: 18px; font-size: 80px; }
      .note { margin-top: 44px; font-size: 44px; }
      /* Adegan 4: tombol berbentuk papan (wajah warna utama di atas dua nada sisi), kontak dengan angka Latin. */
      .tombol { position: relative; display: inline-block; margin-top: 64px; }
      .tombol .alas { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 14px; bottom: -16px; border-radius: 8px;
        background: linear-gradient(to top, var(--gelap) 0 6px, var(--sisi) 6px); }
      .tombol .muka { position: relative; display: block; padding: 30px 54px 32px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--utama);
        color: var(--teks-di-utama); font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 800; font-size: 46px; line-height: 1; will-change: transform; }
      .kontak { margin-top: 64px; font-size: 76px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1; }
      .kecil { margin-top: 22px; font-size: 38px; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      /* Tanda pengenal di kiri bawah, diam sepanjang video: label mono, nama, lima titik palet. */
      #tag { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 1452px; }
      #tag .k { font-family: var(--font-kode); font-weight: 600; font-size: 24px; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      #tag .n { margin-top: 10px; font-family: var(--font-judul); font-weight: 800; font-size: 54px; line-height: 1.15; }
      #tag .n small { margin-left: 16px; font-family: var(--font-angka); font-weight: 700; font-size: 34px; color: var(--teks-redup); }
      #tag .sw { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-top: 12px; }
      #tag .sw i { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; outline: 1px solid var(--garis); }
      /* Lembar transisi: satu bidang warna utama yang meluncur di sumbu isometrik 30°. */
      #tirai { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--utama); visibility: hidden; will-change: transform; }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1080" data-height="1920" data-fps="30">
      <div id="grid"></div>
      <section class="scene" id="s1" data-role="hook">
        <!-- Adegan 1, pembuka: kartu bab. Angka bab dan judul naik dari masker, garis ditarik, label menyusul. -->
        <div class="bab">
          <div class="num angka"><span class="mask"><span class="in">01</span></span></div>
          <div class="judul"><span class="mask"><span class="in">Rakit keyboard</span></span></div>
          <div class="rule" id="rule1"></div>
          <div class="label"><span class="mask"><span class="in">Kelas akhir pekan · Bengkel Ketik</span></span></div>
        </div>
      </section>
      <section class="scene" id="s2" data-role="step">
        <!-- Adegan 2, langkah: kepala dengan garis pisau di angka, lalu tiga papan jatuh dan menumpuk satu per satu. -->
        <div class="kepala">
          <div class="label"><span class="mask"><span class="in">Anatomi keyboard</span></span></div>
          <div class="judul"><span class="mask"><span class="in">Isinya cuma <span class="emph" id="k2">3<i class="pisau"></i></span> lapis</span></span></div>

          const x = 3 * (1 - s) * (1 - s) * s * x1 + 3 * (1 - s) * s * s * x2 + s * s * s;
          if (x < t) a = s; else b = s;

        tl.to(".val .lembut", { autoAlpha: 0, y: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power1.in" }, t + 0.2);
        for (let k = 0; k <= n; k++)

          if (x < t) a = s; else b = s;
        }
        return 3 * (1 - s) * (1 - s) * s * y1 + 3 * (1 - s) * s * s * y2 + s * s * s;
      };
      const SNAP = bez(0.7, 0, 0.2, 1), MASUK = "power3.out";
      const $ = (sel, root = document) => [...root.querySelectorAll(sel)];

      // Papan: belah ketupat 594 × 343 (persegi 420 px diputar isometrik), sisi setebal 16 px: 10 px terang, 6 px gelap.
      // Indeks dicetak di bidang papan (matriks isometrik), label tetap menghadap layar. L1 di bawah, L3 di atas.
      const W = 594, H = 343, h = H / 2;
      const ketupat = (dy) => `0,${h + dy} ${W / 2},${dy} ${W},${h + dy} ${W / 2},${H + dy}`;
      const sisi = (d) => `0,${h} ${W / 2},${H} ${W},${h} ${W},${h + d} ${W / 2},${H + d} 0,${h + d}`;
      const LAPIS = [["L1", "Sirkuit PCB"], ["L2", "Switch pegas"], ["L3", "Tuts keycap"]];
      const tumpukan = (sel, y0, label) => ($(sel)[0].innerHTML = LAPIS.map(([idx, ket], i) =>
        `<div class="lapis${i === LAPIS.length - 1 ? " u" : ""}" style="top: ${y0 - i * 98 - h}px">` +
        `<svg width="${W}" height="${H + 16}" viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H + 16}">` +
        `<polygon class="f-gelap" points="${sisi(16)}" /><polygon class="f-sisi" points="${sisi(10)}" />` +
        `<polygon class="f-atas" points="${ketupat(0)}" />` +
        `<text class="idx" x="34" y="74" transform="matrix(0.7071 -0.4082 0.7071 0.4082 0 ${h})">${idx}</text></svg>` +
        (label ? `<div class="ket">${ket}</div>` : "") + "</div>").join(""));
      tumpukan("#tumpuk", 640, true);
      tumpukan("#mini", 0, false);

      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      // Masuk: naik dari masker 108% → 0, 0,6 s power3.out, baris berikutnya 0,1 s kemudian.
      const naik = (sel, t, each = 0.1) =>
        tl.fromTo(sel, { yPercent: 108 }, { yPercent: 0, duration: 0.6, ease: MASUK, stagger: each }, t);
      // Garis pisau: 0,32 s snap dari kiri, lalu kata kuncinya berganti ke warna utama.
      const pisau = (id, t) => {
        tl.fromTo(`#${id} .pisau`, { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: 0.32, ease: SNAP, transformOrigin: "0% 50%" }, t);
        tl.set(`#${id}`, { attr: { "data-on": 1 } }, t + 0.32);
      };
      // Lembar isometrik: masuk dari kiri bawah, menutup layar di t + 0,42 (adegan ditukar di bawahnya), keluar ke kanan atas.
      const lembar = (t, dari, ke) => {
        const tutup = t + 0.42;
        tl.set("#tirai", { autoAlpha: 1 }, t);
        tl.fromTo("#tirai", { xPercent: -110, yPercent: 113 }, { xPercent: 0, yPercent: 0, duration: 0.42, ease: SNAP, immediateRender: false }, t);
        tl.set(dari, { autoAlpha: 0 }, tutup);
        tl.set(ke, { autoAlpha: 1 }, tutup);
        tl.to("#tirai", { xPercent: 110, yPercent: -113, duration: 0.42, ease: SNAP }, tutup + 0.03);
        tl.set("#tirai", { autoAlpha: 0 }, tutup + 0.45);
      };
      // Hitung lembut: salinan kabur muncul dulu, angka tajam naik 20 px dan menajam 0,15-0,75 s sambil salinannya memudar; nilai dihitung 1,4 s expo.out
      // dengan satu tl.set per frame (angka desimal pakai koma, ",0" dibuang seperti angka bulat).
      const hitung = (t, ke) => {
        const angka = $(".val span"), f = gsap.parseEase("expo.out"), n = 42;
        tl.fromTo(".val .tajam", { autoAlpha: 0, y: 20 }, { autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.6, ease: "power2.out" }, t + 0.15);
        tl.fromTo(".val .lembut", { autoAlpha: 0, y: 20 }, { autoAlpha: 0.85, y: 12, duration: 0.2, ease: "none" }, t);
        tl.to(".val .lembut", { autoAlpha: 0, y: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power1.in" }, t + 0.2);
        for (let k = 0; k <= n; k++)
          tl.set(angka, { textContent: (ke * f(k / n)).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/, "").replace(".", ",") }, t + k / 30);
      };

      // Adegan 1 (0-2,7 s): kartu bab, diam sampai lembar pertama.
      tl.set("#s1", { autoAlpha: 1 }, 0);
      naik("#s1 .num .in", 0.07);
      naik("#s1 .judul .in", 0.17);
      tl.fromTo("#rule1", { scaleX: 0 }, { scaleX: 1, duration: 0.6, ease: MASUK, transformOrigin: "0% 50%" }, 0.5);
      naik("#s1 .label .in", 0.55);
      lembar(2.3, "#s1", "#s2");

      // Adegan 2 (2,7-7,3 s): kepala, pisau di "3", papan jatuh 277 px (z 340 diproyeksikan) tiap 0,38 s.
      naik("#s2 .kepala .in", 2.8);
      pisau("k2", 3.55);
      tl.fromTo("#tumpuk .lapis", { autoAlpha: 0, y: -277 }, { autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.6, ease: MASUK, stagger: 0.38 }, 3.95);
      lembar(6.9, "#s2", "#s3");

      // Adegan 3 (7,3-11,2 s): angka mulai saat lembar sudah lewat; 110 dari 120 peserta = 91,7%.
      hitung(7.75, (110 / 120) * 100);
      naik("#s3 .unit .in", 9.0);
      naik("#s3 .note .in", 9.25);
      pisau("k3", 9.6);
      lembar(10.75, "#s3", "#s4");

      // Adegan 4 (11,2-15 s): kepala, tombol jatuh seperti papan, kontak, tumpukan kecil; pisau di kata kunci, tombol
      // ditekan sekali, lalu semuanya diam 2,1 detik.
      naik("#s4 .label .in", 11.25);
      naik("#s4 .judul .in", 11.35);
      tl.fromTo("#tombol", { autoAlpha: 0, y: -160 }, { autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.6, ease: MASUK }, 11.7);
      naik(["#s4 .kontak .in", "#s4 .kecil .in"], 11.9);
      tl.fromTo("#mini .lapis", { autoAlpha: 0, y: -277 }, { autoAlpha: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.6, ease: MASUK, stagger: 0.16 }, 11.85);
      pisau("k4", 12.2);
      tl.to("#tombol .muka", { y: 11, duration: 0.08, ease: "power2.in" }, 12.62);
      tl.to("#tombol .muka", { y: 0, duration: 0.2, ease: MASUK }, 12.7);
      tl.set({}, {}, 15);

      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
    </script>
  </body>
